I have seen Dr Ahmed and Dr Firth at Elmwood. Although I get really anxious about anything medical, I felt reassured, listened to and validated after my appointments.

Dr Ahmed was calm and maintained professional composure throughout our appointment. She listened, asked open questions and didn't rush me at all.

Dr Firth was friendly and instantly reassuring. Not only did I implicitly trust her medical knowledge, but I felt safe and actually quite happy and optimistic during the appointment.

The reception staff have always been polite on the phone. Ordering a prescription has always been without a hitch.

I'm lucky that this is my GP surgery - long may it continue.

Thank you, Dr Ahmed and Dr Firth
